preprocessing: SimpleImputer(strategy=median) -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression (fitted on training subjects only)

visit_policy.single_visit: If a patient has only one available assessment, that assessment is used.
visit_policy.multiple_visits: If multiple assessments are available, the latest assessment by MR Delay is used.
visit_policy.enforcement: Latest-available-visit policy is enforced by the assessment/application workflow; /predict receives the selected/current assessment values.

probability_semantics: model-estimated screening probability of a dementia-related outcome (NOT Alzheimer's probability, diagnosis probability, or clinical certainty)
known_limitations: Research screening model; not clinically validated.
n = 150 subjects total; 14 Converted subjects; 4 Converted in outer test.
No prospective conversion prediction; latest-visit classification is NOT future conversion prediction.
Two Converted outer-test subjects remain missed (normal-MMSE doppelgangers of Nondemented).
training_dataset_identifier: OASIS OAS2 Dataset.csv (373 rows, 150 subjects); canonical 112/38 subject split
